content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When traditional payment platforms fail, creators in Kenya face the risk of losing access to their markets. By using blockchain-based payments, you eliminate the geographical barriers imposed by these platforms. For instance, USDT on Tron settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, making it an ideal choice for quick, low-cost payments. This infrastructure empowers you to sell your ebooks globally without the constraints of conventional payment systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, ensure you have the necessary tools. Start by setting up a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting. You’ll also need a NOWPayments account for processing cryptocurrency payments. Familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and choose a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. These free resources will form the backbone of your ecommerce operation.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To effectively sell ebooks, integrate a payment processing solution that supports various cryptocurrencies. NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee. Once a payment is confirmed, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your digital products automatically. This setup ensures that your customers receive their purchases instantly while you maintain complete ownership of the transaction and delivery process.
Blockchain payments remove geographical barriers to digital commerce.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once everything is set up, it’s time to go live. Promote your ebook through social media channels and direct traffic to your online store. Ensure your NOWPayments integration is working correctly by performing a test transaction. Once you receive your first payment, analyze the transaction flow and ensure your delivery mechanism is functioning. This initial transaction will serve as a benchmark for future sales and customer interactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Complete ownership of your data and infrastructure sets you apart.

This kit is designed to empower creators in regions where traditional platforms are limited. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.

Yes, creators in Pakistan can sell ebooks by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments, which do not require a Stripe account and allow for global transactions.

You can set up automatic delivery by integrating Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 with your payment processing solution, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation.
What fees should I expect when using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, allowing you to retain a significant portion of your profits while accessing over 300 cryptocurrencies for payments.
